pilot.source: Same-seed strict-mapped SW0097 native32 checkpoint and encoder.
pilot.ids: Same registered 4096 source-ordered training IDs, source shuffle seed 118.
pilot.optimizer: Fresh Adam; one unique-union clip at 1.0 and one step per logical batch.

common_objective.description: Unchanged SW0135 native32 source phase-primary + 5*actual-spike positive-product Q objective, coherence coefficient 1.0 and registered density prior.
common_objective.control: Train source encoder and native learned graph only.
common_objective.context_candidate: Add the registered zero-output multiscale context residual encoder; no added RGB loss, labels, or object counts.
common_objective.cross_view_candidate: Original source encoder and graph with canonical old objective plus lambda times symmetric cross-view temporal InfoNCE.

context_residual.fusion: Concatenate 64 channels, GELU branches, Conv1x1 64->8 initialized exactly zero; clamp(F+residual,-3,3), then registered adaptive pooling32.
context_residual.first_step: Output projection can learn; hidden branch gradients are expected zero at exact zero-output initialization.
context_residual.second_step: Verify finite hidden-branch credit after a disposable first update.

cross_view.augmentation: Per-image scalar x'=clamp(c*(x-.5)+.5+b,0,1); c uniform[.9,1.1], b uniform[-.03,.03]; no crop/resize/hue change.
cross_view.embedding: Raw emitted 4x512 spikes flattened to 2048 and L2-normalized with eps 1e-8; no mean-time, centering, phase, or learned projection.
cross_view.negatives: 32 deterministically sampled patches from other images in the same B4 microbatch; no same-image negatives.
cross_view.objective: Symmetric two-direction InfoNCE, temperature .10, mean over patches/images.
cross_view.lambda: Source0 first four logical TRAIN batches; .25*median(accumulated old encoder+graph grad norm / accumulated contrastive encoder+graph grad norm); one frozen coefficient for the seed1 pilot.

evaluation.endpoint: Original native32 actual-spike QCC, fixed SW0137 320-image IDs, unchanged production readout.
evaluation.pilot_expansion: Each candidate must exceed both mapped source1 and paired control foreground ARI with positive common-image paired 95% lower bounds before considering seeds0/2.
evaluation.limits: Seed1 is a bounded representation pilot, not a three-seed win, gate-necessity result, or fresh-initialization scaling proof.

exposure_note: Cross-view arm uses two transformed views of the same 4096 unique images (8192 image-view exposures); this is an objective-plus-augmentation intervention, not FLOP-matched training.
